newsitem.title: USA: Marks Bros. Jewelers Q3 helped by margins.
newsitem.headline: Marks Bros. Jewelers Q3 helped by margins.

text.p: Marks Brothers Jewelers Inc said Thursday higher third quarter operating margins helped the jewelry retailer rebound from a $2-million loss in the same period a year ago.

"We posted a solid increase in operating margins," Marks Brothers Chairman, President and Chief Executive Hugh Patinkin said, "which was primarily a result of continued leverage of our buying and occupancy costs."
The company reported net income of $457,000 in the latest third quarter on sales of $32.6 million.
Marks Brothers Jewelers is a retail jewelry chain with 164 stores in 24 states.
Shares of Marks Brothers Jewelers were trading unchanged at 21.
